quests.title: ARED Heavy Resistive Loading
quests.description: High-load axial skeletal compression (Squat, Deadlift, Heel-raise) at 70-85% 1RM to simulate Earth gravitational loading and inhibit osteoclast demineralization.
quests.source: NASA HRP Human Physiology Countermeasures: ARED Flight Protocol (NASA-STD-3001)

quests.title: CEVIS High-Intensity Aerobic Intervals
quests.description: Cycle Ergometer with Vibration Isolation and Stabilization (CEVIS) 4x4 interval protocol (4 min at 85% VO2max, 3 min active recovery) to maintain left ventricular volume and stroke volume.
quests.source: Hughson RL et al., Cardiovascular deconditioning countermeasures, J Appl Physiol 2016

quests.title: Cabin Circadian Light Phase Alignment
quests.description: Shift cabin Solid-State Light Assemblies (SSLA) to 480nm blue-depleted, red-dominant spectrum (< 2700K, < 10 lux) 2 hours prior to sleep anchor window to trigger endogenous melatonin secretion.
quests.source: Brainard GC et al., Solid-state lighting countermeasures for ISS crew, Lighting Res Technol 2016

quests.title: Cephalad Counter-Fluid & Electrolyte Loading
quests.description: Ingest 1.0 liter isotonic electrolyte beverage (8g sodium chloride equivalent) with water to offset spaceflight natriuresis and sustain effective circulating arterial plasma volume.
quests.source: NASA Flight Rule MED-B24: Fluid & Electrolyte Loading Protocols; NASA-STD-3001

quests.title: Radiation Storm Shelter Staging Drill
quests.description: Verify storm shelter consumables, water-wall polyethylene integrity, and CPDS dosimeter telemetry sync to ensure crew can retreat within 15 minutes of an SPE alarm.
quests.source: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) Operational Procedures

quests.title: Neuro-Behavioral Journaling & Earth Connection
quests.description: Structured self-reflection or asynchronous audio recording to family/ground support to mitigate sensory deprivation, interpersonal tension, and isolation drift.
quests.source: Kanas N. et al., Psychological countermeasures for long-duration space missions, Acta Astronautica 2011
